name: Affection
source:
A story about a young boy, teased by classmates. His only friend is his math tutor, David, but maybe his feelings for him are changing...

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/affection.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一位受到同学嘲弄的少年。他唯一的朋友是数学家教戴维，但他对戴维的感情，也许正在发生变化…

（摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/affection.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
